english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical plate, and in context it can also mean one plateful or serving.
Use 碟 as the all-purpose word for an individual eating plate or a plateful of food.

examples.english: This dish is holding some vegetables.
examples.jyutping: ni1 zek3 dip6 zong1 zyu6 di1 coi3

examples.english: This plate of food smells great.
